text:
Kai: Heads-up — canary token/sec down ~28% since rolling scheduler PR 3581. Observed at 21:10 UTC on canary-3. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/perf?run=2123

Maya: ugh — is this the kernel-selector change or batching heuristics? :thinking_face:

Kai: My hunch: startup pacing tweak in ctb scheduler combined with KV-cache cold path leads to lots of tiny batches during warmup. CPU profiles show extra memcpy on fallback path.

Liam: CI perf-run flagged this earlier: `perf/inference/throughput` failed on canary. Link: https://ci.redwood/inference/2123

perf-bot: CI PERF FAILURE: throughput drop > 20% vs baseline (master@a1b2c3). See artifacts: s3://perf-artifacts/2123

Nora: Can you paste the flamegraph snippet? I want to see kernel vs memcopy time.

Kai: Pasting sampled stack from canary (hot path truncated):
```
0.41%  runtime  memcpy
12.33% runtime  kernel_dispatch
22.12% runtime  continuous_batcher::form_batch
15.89% runtime  scheduler::pace_loop
```
Memcopy spikes line up with KV cache miss amplification.

Maya: Interesting — scheduler::pace_loop increased wait granularity in PR 3581 to reduce busy-wait. Maybe start-up pacing added delay before coalescing.

Liam: Quick bisect attempt: rolling back `scheduler/pacing: reduce-granularity` locally reverts token/sec drop on canary staging. Reproducer: run `bazel test //runtime/throughput:smoketest --config=canary` with `--env=KV_HITRATE=0.1`.

Kai: Confirmed locally: revert patch fixes ~25% of throughput loss during first 60s. After warmup, difference narrows.

Nora: So it's a warmup/regression - not steady-state. We should block the rollout until we have a fix or mitigations (KV prefetch or pacing tweak).

Maya: Proposal: add short-circuit for cold-start path — when KV hitrate < 0.5 for first N seconds, fall back to previous pacing (coalesce aggressively). Also add a perf test in CI that simulates cold KV.

Liam: +1. Also add a telemetry metric: `scheduler.startup_small_batch_frac` and `kvcache.hits_during_startup` so we can alert before rollout.

perf-bot: Note added: regression-tracker/3581 => severity=high, rollout=held

deploy-bot: Rollout paused for 3581 on all clusters.

Kai: I'll open PR with two changes: 1) conditional pacing heuristic toggle, 2) CI perf test simulating KV cold misses. Will link before EOD.

Nora: Thanks. Assign to Kai + Maya for patch review. We'll re-run canary once CI passes.

Maya: Also add a short doc snippet in eng-runtime/README about startup pacing behavior — so SREs understand warmup tradeoffs.

Kai: PR: https://git.redwood/r/runtime/pulls/3594 — contains benchmark output.

Liam: Nice. Once merged, we should run a soak with KV hitrate knob at 0.05 for 10m.

Kai: Agreed. I'll coordinate with SRE for soak window.

Maya: :thumbsup:
